control-plane.description: Default in-process runtime for lightweight orchestration and CPU-safe tools.
notes: Use for API, planner, schema work, metadata tools, and deterministic report packaging.
This should stay small and stable.

legacy-qwen-vllm.description: Shared conda environment on compute nodes for legacy v3 MRI tools and GPU-capable Python packages.
notes: Best near-term bridge for tools already proven in v3.
Prefer this before building per-tool containers.

cp082-qwen-vllm.description: Run GPU-required legacy v3 tools on esplhpc-cp082 over SSH against the shared /common workspace.
notes: Use when the current control node has no visible GPU.
Assumes payload/output paths live on the shared filesystem.

apptainer-medgemma.description: Run heavyweight MRI tools on esplhpc-cp082 inside Apptainer while reusing the validated qwen_vllm conda env from the shared filesystem.
notes: Container path for cp082 when reproducibility and launcher provenance matter more than the bare shared-env path.
Current implementation pins the base Python image but still reuses the host qwen_vllm conda env inside the container.
PYTHONPATH is intentionally cleaned so the container does not inherit the control-plane virtualenv site-packages.
Mirrors the 'inference' tier of BCER_open configs/tool_runtime.yml.
conda_env is mandatory: without it _worker_command() falls back to sys.executable and GPU segmentation would silently run inside the API interpreter.
Provision with: conda env create -f envs/inference.yml
Can later be migrated behind Apptainer if the conda stack becomes brittle.

cardiac-nnunet-gpu.description: GPU runtime for the vendored nnUNet V1 cardiac cine fork (BCER 'cardiac' tier).
notes: Mirrors the 'cardiac' tier of BCER_open configs/tool_runtime.yml.
Kept separate from nnunet-gpu because the nnUNet V1 deps (batchgenerators, MedPy, numpy<2) conflict with the MONAI inference tier.
Provision with: conda env create -f envs/cardiac.yml, then pip install -e external/nnunet_phys_seg.
